purpose: Development verification only; not final thesis performance or detection accuracy

settings.browser_context: fresh per attempt; workspace loaded before timer

limitations: Two measured attempts per scenario and viewport, with one excluded warm-up each.
Reused source-matching runtime images; runner working tree dirty; no release freeze.
Narrow viewport uses the same workstation, not mobile hardware.
Readiness is decoded, stable scene layout, not physical paint or full viewport visibility.
Post-timer screenshots scroll to the scene; they do not show viewport position at timer stop.
Explicit MIME fixture payload does not verify native file chooser compatibility.
One traffic scene group and an artificial video timeline; no natural-motion or broad scene claim.
No concurrent local test suite during collection; exclusive host/GPU use not established.
